help.title: How the portal works
help.lead: The portal is the instruction mirror of the technical block: it answers what to do, by when and with which form. The source of truth for forms is Google Drive.
glossary: Client's Service - manages construction on behalf of the company
Head of Client's Service - operational management of the vertical
Production & Technical Dept - single point of documentation and the payment filter
Project Manager - delivers the project within budget
Worksection - the corporate task system, the single source of truth
Document groups: А - calendar · Б - monthly cycle · В - resources · Г - quality and changes · Д - checklists · Е - regulations
help.indexHint: Codes like Б1 or Е3 are document indices. Every code on the site is clickable and leads to the document page.
